_doc: Fictional coastal-strip variant of gulf_coastal_highrisk_2027. [lon,lat] polygons are metric buffers about an approximate shoreline corridor, not exact county boundaries. Buffer half-width 23 miles for HIGH; additional smoothing and land clipping by renderer.
scenario_label: MOCK / SIMULATION ONLY - Not an official NWS product
categorical_note: Narrow coastal High Risk: Matagorda Bay to lower Plaquemines. 30% tornado + Intensity 2; localized Intensity 3. Approximate 45-55 mile-wide corridor before land clipping.

tornado.note: Repeated coastal supercells; 30% tornado + Intensity 2. Intensity 3 core: upper Texas coast to Vermilion Bay. Coastal boundary position is critical.

wind.note: 45% damaging wind in the coastal corridor; locally 65-80 mph gusts. Tornado potential drives the High Risk.

hail.note: 15% large hail in the broader surrounding area; generally 1-1.75 inches. Elevated storms extend inland.
